segment.source: Expander reveals content on demand without leaving the current context. It supports multiple expansion directions, size variants, icon placement, icon-only triggers, nested panels, ghost style, and custom spacing.
segment.target: Expander reveals conteúdo em demand sem leaving o atual context. Isso oferece suporte múltiplos expansion directions, tamanho variantes, ícone posicionamento, ícone-somente triggers, nested painéis, ghost estilo, e personalizado espaçamento.

segment.source: Show or hide a single section of supporting content.
segment.target: Mostrar ou hide a single section de supporting conteúdo.

segment.source: Body element with padding, background color and text styles for the panel content area; it materializes on first expansion.
segment.target: Body element com padding, background color e text styles para o panel content area; isso materializes em first expansion.

segment.source: Header element with padding, background color, font size, line height and cursor style for the panel header
segment.target: Header element com padding, background color, font size, line-height e cursor style para o panel header

segment.source: Icon element with icon size, placement, margin and rotation transforms for the expand/collapse arrow
segment.target: Icon element com icon size, placement, margin e rotation transforms para o expand/collapse arrow

segment.source: Use owner-scoped selectors and Expander property selectors to customize the published Semantic Parts.
segment.target: Use owner-scoped selectors e Expander property selectors para customize o published Semantic Parts.

segment.source: Root element with border thickness, visual mode and expansion state that control the overall appearance of the panel
segment.target: Root element com border thickness, visual mode e expansion state that control o overall appearance of o panel

segment.source: Title element with layout, foreground color and typography styles for the header text
segment.target: Title element com layout, foreground color e typography styles para o header text

segment.source: Ant Design supports a default Expander size as well as a large and small size. If a large or small Expander is desired, set the size property to either large or small respectively. Omit the size property for a Expander with the default size.
segment.target: Ant Design oferece suporte a padrão Expander tamanho as well as a grande e pequeno tamanho. Se a grande ou pequeno Expander é desired, definir o tamanho propriedade para either grande ou pequeno respectively. Omit o tamanho propriedade para a Expander com o padrão tamanho.
